text:
Maya R: quick accessibility sweep on the Models list in dark theme — noticed focus ring almost invisible on keyboard nav. attaching a quick gif soon.
Sam T: oh yeah saw that earlier, the outline is using rgba(0,0,0,0.2) which disappears on #0b0f14 background.
Rachel (PM): is this the row focus or the action pill focus? which control do we want to prioritize for keyboard users?
Maya R: row focus. tab -> lands on the model row, but focus ring is faint and NVDA reads nothing useful (just 'group').
Javi G: sounds like a couple issues: contrast + semantic roles. if rows are divs we need roving tabindex + role="listbox"/"option" or make them real buttons/links.
Kevin - Design: i prefer keeping rows clickable (open details) but also having discrete action buttons. can we avoid turning the whole row into a native button? UX nuance.
Maya R: if we keep divs, add role="button" and tabindex="0" + aria-label that includes model name + status. but better is to implement roving tabindex so only one element is tabbable. arrow keys to move between rows.
Sam T: agree on roving. implementation note: need to ensure focus-visible style is strong in dark theme, e.g.:
```css
.row:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(94, 234, 212, 0.16), 0 0 0 1px #3be0c7; /* teal halo */
  border-radius: 6px;
}
```
Maya R: that halo hits contrast better. we should aim for >= 3:1 against bg for focus indicator to be perceivable.
Rachel (PM): how about screen reader phrasing? NVDA/readers need actionable name: e.g. 'Model: llama-13b, deployment healthy, press enter to open details'.
Maya R: yes — aria-label example: `aria-label="Model {name}, {status}. Press Enter to open details."` for the row/button.
Javi G: small perf/markup note: avoid duplicating long aria-labels for every row if we can, maybe use aria-roledescription + accessible name from visible text. but do include status badges with `aria-hidden=true` and combine in visible label when necessary.
Sam T: also found a SR issue on truncated names — VoiceOver doesn't announce the full name unless we expose it in accessible name. solution: include the full name in `aria-label` or `title` attribute.
Kevin - Design: for truncated chips let's add `aria-describedby` pointing to an offscreen element that contains full name? is that OK accessibility-wise?
Maya R: `aria-describedby` works but can be noisy if it reads a lot. aria-label is more succinct. prefer aria-label for rows, keep `aria-describedby` for optional extra context (e.g., version notes).
A11yBot: automated audit summary: 1 critical (focus contrast), 2 major (role/roving-tabindex), 4 minor (aria-label/truncation, badge announce), scanned 120 nodes.
Rachel (PM): thanks. can we add a small e2e check + axe to guard this? Sam, Javi can you pair on a test?
Sam T: yeah I can add a Puppeteer + axe test:
```js
it('models list is keyboard navigable', async () => {
  await page.goto('/console/models');
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  const active = await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.getAttribute('role') || document.activeElement.tagName);
  expect(active).toBe('button' /* or listbox option */);
  const results = await axe.run(page);
  expect(results.violations.filter(v => v.id === 'color-contrast').length).toBe(0);
});
```
Javi G: i'll prototype roving tabindex hook (small reusable hook) and make sure arrow keys + home/end behave. will annotate keyboard docs.
Maya R: note for devs: when using `role="listbox"` make sure to expose `aria-activedescendant` updates if using actual DOM focus on container. if we go with native focus on items we can avoid that complexity.
Sam T: timeline? can we ship a fix in the next patch release (this week) — if it's a CSS tweak + aria-label might be quick.
Kevin - Design: i'll update the token for focus halo color in Figma and push values (teal 3be0c7) to the theme.
Rachel (PM): priority = p2 for now, but move to p1 if customer-facing bug reports come in.
Maya R: followups:
- Javi to open PR for roving hook + small demo (D: 2 days)
- Sam to add axe e2e test + CI check (D: 2 days)
- Kevin to update design token + screenshot for QA
- I'll re-run NVDA/VoiceOver pass after PR.
A11yBot: reminder: `:axe` baseline saved to /tests/fixtures/axe-baseline.json
Sam T: sounds good. cc @everyone if needed, will post PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
Rachel (PM): thanks team!
Kevin - Design: quick nit — let's ensure focus halo doesn't overlap the row edge when list has rounded corners (add 4px inset).
Maya R: noted. we'll iterate. :white_check_mark:
